programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Antardwand
programme.desc: Mani, a spoiled brat, is brought up in a caste-ridden society. When he is sent to his uncle's house for studies, he finds his life entangled in a situation of love, revenge and gratitude.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely?

programme.title: Hiraasat

programme.desc: Highest Highs, Lowest Lows. Josh Gates recounts members' death-defying exploits! Two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific and a pilot skydives from the edge of space. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Ed Stafford: First Man Out

programme.desc: Shouldn't Be Selling It. At auction, Wayne works with a collector who has last-minute doubts about selling his collection. Plus, Wayne's '30 Ford Model A faces stiff competition. S11, Ep6

programme.desc: 10 Million Dollar Fixer Upper. Wayne and the team join a multi-shop mission get a coveted, seven-figure 1937 Bugatti ready for the most prestigious exhibition in the world. S11, Ep7

programme.title: Chasing Classic Cars
programme.desc: Twist And Scout. Wayne buys the motorcycle of his dreams, an all-original 1928 Indian Scout 101. Plus, he finds homes for a 1977 Mercedes 450 and an Audi R8. S11, Ep8

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Introducing The Kindig Cf1. Dave and the team are putting the final touches on two remarkable 1953 Corvettes. Will their demanding clients be satisfied with the final product? S8, Ep8

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: How We Got Here. Dave and the team celebrate their 100th episode by sharing some of their favourite memories. Plus, the team show off their best projects in Las Vegas. S8, Ep9

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Strawberry Rolls Forever. A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s. S8, Ep10

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: New York, New York. Dave and Kev head to Lake George for the Adirondack Nationals. The entire town shuts down for this car show, attracting the best on the East Coast. S8, Ep11

programme.title: Junkyard Empire
programme.desc: Junkyard Treasure. When people look out at Andy's junkyard all they see is junk, but he sees possibilities. With the junkyard filled, Andy's on the hunt for new ways to move parts. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Junkyard Empire
programme.desc: Putting Out Fires. For their businesses to thrive, Andy, Bobby and their team find the proverbial diamonds in the rough, chase down deals, and add value to what others throw away. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: A Brave New World. Richard Hammond eyes a classic Bentley driven with synthetic fuel at Goodwood. Plus, the Hammond family's Discovery breaks down, leaving Mindy stranded. S3, Ep3

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Passion Over Profit. Anthony gets the chance to do driver training in a race-spec Nissan Skyline GTR at Donington Park. And a bizarre military vehicle enters the workshop. S3, Ep4

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Everything But The Kitchen Sink. The shop is buzzing with activity, and the latest CF1 presents a new challenge for the guys as Dave makes modifications to the original. S9, Ep19

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Automotive Oasis. The crew prep for the last car show of the year as the 10 best cars from across the US come to Scottsdale, Arizona. Plus, Dave restocks his toolbox. S9, Ep20

programme.title: Extinct Or Alive
programme.desc: The Caribbean Monk Seal. Forrest sets off on a dangerous, shark-infested search for the extinct Caribbean monk seal. He and the crew come face-to-face with a giant tiger shark. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Extinct or Alive: Jaws of Alaska
programme.desc: Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante travels the world in search of rare and elusive wildlife, including those lost to science, and cold-water sharks.

programme.desc: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

programme.desc: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Great Patty Caper: SpongeBob, Patrick and Plankton solve a mystery on a runaway train.

programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony in 'The Starry Awards', and then in 'Blorpsgiving', Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family. (S1, ep 23)

programme.desc: SpongeBob volunteers to babysit 'Sandy's Nutty Nieces', then in 'Insecurity Guards', SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.

programme.desc: When SpongeBob cooks at home, Mr. Krabs' customers leave his restaurant in 'SpongeBob's Place', then in 'Plankton Gets the Boot', Plankton gets kicked out of the house.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: In 'The Nasty Patty', SpongeBob thinks a Krabby Patty has caused the health inspector to meet an early end, then in 'The Idiot Box', SpongeBob shows Squidward about imagination.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob wonders if he can be grown up and still kiss his Granny in "Grandma's Kisses", and then in "Squidville", Squidward moves away - but surely he's not missing SpongeBob? (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob has to run the Krusty Krab for 15 whole minutes, but is led astray by Squidward, in 'Gullible Pants', and then in 'Overbooked', SpongeBob just doesn't have time to help all of his friends.

programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.desc: ...Pursuit: Tangled Terror: Messy mayhem as Stu and Liv outwit a blue tongue lizard. Jess and Dan free a trapped snake before Mick and Adele rush a python rescue fast! (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Aggressive behaviour is not limited to the most obvious culprits. Discover how koalas, cockatoos, clownfish and more can exhibit surprising behaviours in order to survive. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: From lionfish to nudibranchs, these animals employ extravagant behaviours to entice mates or warn off predators, proving that standing out can be the ultimate survival strategy. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Join the search for a Cooper's hawk who's taken a dangerous dip in a backyard pool. Catch the hijinks of the centre's skunks as they try to avoid getting their shots. (3 of 12)

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: When a baby mink is abandoned in a store, the team gets to work on some behavioural training. But will this sweet little one be tough enough for the wild when they're done? (4 of 12)

programme.title: Nature's Dress Code: Who Wears...
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Every living creature needs a suitable coat. Dive deep into the fashion styles of the natural world with this colourful documentary.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli
programme.desc: Watch evolution happen in real time as the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, learn to use tools, interact with fire and adapt to the human world.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: Life in the Wet Zone: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday we follow him through the the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew.. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: In celebration of Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, we explore the secret life of plants at Kew, following along as he examines everything. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom Of Plants
programme.desc: David Attenborough concludes his absorbing journey around London's Kew Gardens, as he discovers how some plants have evolved to shed their dependency on water. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Enchanted Waters
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle and walk tall with flamingos. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Grasslands: Explore one of Earth's most vital habitats and learn how grasslands can slow climate change. Meet the key species, such as bison, that could restore this resource. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: Hollywoods Held Hostage: The Hollywood pride is in serious trouble! Having fled north to escape the Nomads, other lions move in and threaten to take over their territory. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: The Next Dynasty: The MK pride faces its toughest moment yet as their matriarch and best hunter Surabi's life hangs in the balance after being gored by a buffalo. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: New: Planet Weird
programme.desc: The Wander Years: Journey with nature's nomads and hitchhikers, from monarch butterflies on an epic migration to the extraordinary hidden world within a sloth's fur. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: New: Big Cats, Nine Lives
programme.desc: Tiger: Follow a tiger from tiny cub to formidable hunter, as instinct and stealth guide it through a solitary world of shifting territories, fierce rivalry and ever-present danger. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Dragons And Damsels
programme.desc: They are beautiful, their behaviour is as complex as mammals and they have existed since the dinosaurs. David Attenborough uncovers the life of dragonflies and damselflies.

programme.title: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers
programme.desc: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers: Jellyfish blooms are on the rise. Could these ancient survivors be reshaping the oceans and challenging life beneath the waves?

programme.title: Obama And Attenborough
programme.desc: In celebration of his 100th birthday, we look back to naturalist Sir David Attenborough and President Barack Obama as they talk careers and the record-breaking Great Barrier Reef dive.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making Of Motown

programme.title: Nick Cave's Veiled World

programme.title: Rise Of The Superheroes

programme.title: The Assassination Of John Lennon

programme.desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, Kamalakannan's grandmother does not want Bharathi to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.

programme.title: Bank Chor
programme.desc: Three inexperienced robbers who try to rob a bank get into trouble when they make a mess of things and the robbery goes wrong.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Jalwa
programme.desc: When Raj, a happy-go-lucky orphan, learns that he is the illegitimate son of successful businessman Rajesh Mittal, he travels to the UK to claim his rightful place in the family.

programme.title: Band Baaja Baaraat
programme.desc: Two ambitious wedding planners team up to start a business but struggle to balance love and work. Their chemistry, conflicts, and creativity bring to life a vibrant tale of dreams and relationships.

programme.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
programme.desc: NRI Raj follows Simran to India to win over her strict father and marry her.

programme.title: Housefull 4
programme.desc: Six lovers reincarnate after 600 years, meeting again in modern times with hilarious consequences. Mixing fantasy, comedy, and romance, it's a chaotic story of love beyond lifetimes.

programme.title: Race 2
programme.desc: Ranvir treads through the world of the Indian mafia in Turkey as he looks to avenge the death of his lover and partner-in-crime.

programme.title: Main Hi Raja Main Hi Mantri
programme.desc: Jogendra, a moneylender, seeks political power after his wife's insult by the village Sarpanch's wife, fueling his ambition and conflict.

programme.title: Rowdy Sarkar
programme.desc: Dreams of an aspiring cricketer comes crashing down when he is engulfed in a false naxal case and turns to a life of crime, gaining the name of Railway Raju.

programme.title: Baabul
programme.desc: A grieving father encourages his widowed daughter-in-law to remarry, challenging conservative traditions. The emotional story explores love, loss, and the courage to redefine family bonds in society.

programme.title: Son of Sardaar
programme.desc: A man returns to his parents' village and becomes the newest target in a long-running family feud, bringing past tensions back to life.

programme.title: Hulchul (2004)
programme.desc: Two feuding families' children fall in love, sparking comedy and chaos. The film mixes romance, laughter, and drama, proving that love can bloom even amid deep-rooted enmity.

programme.title: Chak De India
programme.desc: Kabir Khan, disgraced ex-captain, coaches the struggling Indian Women's Hockey team. He aims to unite them, instilling pride and belief to achieve victory for India.

programme.title: Golmaal - Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: Friends Gopal, Lucky, Madhav and Laxman often dupe gullible people out of their money. Hilarity ensues when they target a middle-aged couple and simultaneously try wooing their beautiful neighbour.

programme.title: Aavesham
programme.desc: Three engineering students arrive in Bangalore for their studies but soon get caught in a conflict. Struggling to handle the situation, they turn to a local gangster for help, risking everything.

programme.title: Maragathananayam
programme.desc: Aadhavan and Maya unravel the mystery of Maragathananayam, confronting supernatural curses, hidden treasure secrets and life-threatening ancient powers

programme.title: Sooper Se Ooper
programme.desc: Ranvir and Kukreja fight to claim a valuable plot in Mumbai. Ranvir must find his uncle to secure it, while Kukreja does everything possible to stop him, leading to intense rivalry and drama.

programme.title: Tikdam
programme.desc: A devoted father faces tough choices when a job offer in Mumbai threatens to separate him from his family. His children unite to save their town, sparking hope.

programme.title: Aaja Nachle
programme.desc: Dia returns home to find her beloved dance theatre facing demolition. Determined to save it, she inspires the indifferent townspeople to join a dance performance and fight for its survival.

programme.title: ABCD 2
programme.desc: An Indian street dance troupe from Mumbai strives for fame, falls, then fights to regain glory on stage, ABCD 2 testing love, friendship, and redemption.

programme.title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
programme.desc: Anjali loves her best friend Rahul but is heartbroken when he marries Tina. Years later, Rahul's daughter, knowing their past, sets out to reunite him with Anjali, hoping for a second chance at love.

programme.title: Jolly Llb 3
programme.desc: Jolly Mishra takes on a powerful legal battle with Judge Tripathi overseeing, exposing corruption while balancing humor, courtroom drama and moral dilemmas

programme.title: Arjun Reddy
programme.desc: Arjun Reddy, a successful young medical surgeon, sets out on the path of self-destruction when his lady-love is forced to marry another man.

programme.title: Luv Ka The End
programme.desc: Rhea dreams of marrying her boyfriend but plans revenge when she finds out that he is using her to score points.

programme.title: Patna Shukla
programme.desc: Tanvi Shukla, a Patna lower-court lawyer, pursues her childhood dream with determination, balancing professional ambition, ethical challenges, and personal growth along the legal journey.

programme.title: Action Replayy
programme.desc: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations.

programme.title: Ladies Vs Ricky Bahl
programme.desc: A smooth-talking con man lives by deceiving women until fate turns on him. His own schemes backfire, teaching him that tricks come back to trap the trickster. In the end, justice prevails.

programme.title: Hungama (2003)
programme.desc: A web of misunderstandings brings together quirky characters in hilarious situations. Chaos, love, and laughter define this classic Priyadarshan comedy about life's funny coincidences.

programme.title: Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi
programme.desc: Surinder, a simple man, falls for a vivacious Tani and gets married to her. In order to impress her, he undergoes a complete makeover and becomes Raj.

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: Gangsters Sagar and Uday decide to abandon crime, but their plans falter when they struggle to find a suitable groom for their sister, tempting them to return to their old ways.

programme.title: A Thursday
programme.desc: One fateful Thursday in the city of Mumbai invites tremendous horror when Naina, a nursery school teacher, holds 16 children hostage and produces a list of unfathomable demands.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: A portrait photographer tries to capture two key expressions from his girlfriend for a top contest, risking their relationship and his sanity in the process.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: Shiva and Keerai, who are known for kidnapping girls, are forced by a gangster to kidnap a politician's daughter due to a blunder committed by Keerai.

programme.title: Deewana Mastana
programme.desc: Neha, a psychiatrist, is pursued by both Raja, a small-time crook, and Bunnu, a patient. Things take a hilarious turn when the two try to outsmart each other to win Neha's heart.

programme.title: Chandni Chowk To China
programme.desc: A humble cook from Delhi believes he's the reincarnation of a Chinese warrior. Thrust into an epic adventure, he discovers courage, identity, and humor in this martial arts comedy.

programme.title: Kyo Kii Main Jhuth Nahi Bolta
programme.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble.

programme.title: Pathaan
programme.desc: An Indian agent races against a doomsday clock as a ruthless mercenary, with a bitter vendetta, mounts an apocalyptic attack against the country.

programme.title: Awara Paagal Deewana
programme.desc: Dr Anmol, a henpecked dentist in New York, suffers under his domineering wife. His miserable life turns chaotic when he unknowingly gets caught in a dangerous mafia rivalry.

programme.title: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior

programme.title: Coolie: The Powerhouse
programme.desc: Deva learns his friend Rajshekar was murdered and discovers a chair that turns bodies to ash. With Preeti, he exposes smuggling ring and seeks justice.

programme.title: Hulla
programme.desc: Raj and his wife expect peace in the their new flat. But thanks to the watchman's whistle Raj becomes sleep-deprived.

programme.title: Dil Bechara

programme.title: Dhol

programme.title: The Runaway Train
programme.desc: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts & Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: How To Undress in Public
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Compton Bennett. Stars Fenella Fielding, Reginald Beckwith & Kenneth Connor. A comedic take on the different methods of undressing through the ages.

programme.title: Richard's Things
programme.desc: 1980. Starring Liv Ullman and Amanda Redman. Richard dies of a heart attack whilst away on business, when collecting his things his wife learns that he had been travelling with another woman.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: No Particular Theme. 1976. Interesting Stories. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Ray Alan, Thora Hird, George Melly and Spike Milligan.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Imposters. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Brenda de Banzie & Jack Melford. Robin and Maid Marian assist Lady Pomfret, who has acquired the help of an imposter in order to keep her estate.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Deep Seven. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The team begin extending Supercar's range by testing its underwater abilities, but the craft begins to experience a series of malfunctions.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Serpent Beneath. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Zena Marshall. A renowned playwright becomes stale so he steals the play of an unknown author which gets him involved in complications.

programme.title: Danger By My Side
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Stars Anthony Oliver, Maureen Connell, Bill Nagy. With the help of the Met police a girl tracks down the killers of her detective brother.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Two Time Loser. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Blonde Crazy
programme.desc: 1931. Romance/Drama. Directed by Roy Del Ruth. Stars James Cagney, Joan Blondell & Noel Francis. The adventures of a conman and his glamorous girlfriend who scam their way to the top.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: The Great Gold Robbery. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Peter Allenby & John Howlett. Thieves target the Edinburgh to London mail train; the only clue Maguire finds is a footprint by the railway track.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Distance. 1975. Stars Ian Cullen, Ralph Bates & Lynda Bellingham. Joe Skinner fancies a woman. She seems to fancy him. So why is he investigating her background?

programme.title: Frozen Planet

programme.title: Frozen Planet
